## Install Go module

```
go get github.com/golang-cz/ringbuf
```

```go
import "github.com/golang-cz/ringbuf"
```

## Agent skill

ringbuf ships a skill that teaches coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others) to use it correctly. Install it with:

```
npx skills add golang-cz/ringbuf
```

See [skills/ringbuf/SKILL.md](https://github.com/golang-cz/ringbuf/blob/master/skills/ringbuf/SKILL.md).
